changeSet.comment: Permit institute data administrators and department-scoped data administrators to publish quality-passed models directly while preserving actor, timestamp and optional legacy review evidence.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE modeling_model_release_candidate DROP CONSTRAINT ck_model_release_candidate_audit; ALTER TABLE modeling_model_release_candidate ADD CONSTRAINT ck_model_release_candidate_audit CHECK ( ((submitted_by IS NULL AND submitted_date IS NULL) OR ( submitted_by IS NOT NULL AND btrim(submitted_by) <> '' AND submitted_by = btrim(submitted_by) AND submitted_date IS NOT NULL )) AND ((approved_by IS NULL AND approved_date IS NULL) OR ( approved_by IS NOT NULL AND btrim(approved_by) <> '' AND approved_by = btrim(approved_by) AND approved_date IS NOT NULL )) AND ((published_by IS NULL AND published_date IS NULL) OR ( published_by IS NOT NULL AND btrim(published_by) <> '' AND published_by = btrim(published_by) AND published_date IS NOT NULL )) AND last_modified_date >= created_date AND (submitted_date IS NULL OR submitted_date >= created_date) AND (approved_date IS NULL OR (submitted_date IS NOT NULL AND approved_date >= submitted_date)) AND (published_date IS NULL OR published_date >= COALESCE(approved_date, submitted_date, created_date)) AND (submitted_by IS NULL OR approved_by IS NULL OR btrim(submitted_by) <> btrim(approved_by)) AND (submitted_date IS NULL OR last_modified_date >= submitted_date) AND (approved_date IS NULL OR last_modified_date >= approved_date) AND (published_date IS NULL OR last_modified_date >= published_date) AND ( status = 'STALE' OR status NOT IN ('REVIEW_PENDING', 'REJECTED', 'APPROVED') OR submitted_date IS NOT NULL ) AND ( status = 'STALE' OR status NOT IN ('APPROVED') OR approved_date IS NOT NULL ) AND ( status = 'STALE' OR status NOT IN ('PARTIAL', 'PUBLISHED', 'ROLLED_BACK') OR published_date IS NOT NULL ) );
